publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the algorithm for exponential approximation characterization.

articleTitle: Radiating System on the Basis of Ring Hybrid Metal-Dielectric Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of ring hybrid metal-dielectric structure experimental investigation. Peculiarities of radiating slot and ring resonator interaction have been investigated. Constructs influence on energy characteristics has been shown.

articleTitle: Two Types of Adaptive Sampling in Networked PID Control: Time-Variant Periodic and Deadband Sampling
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Adaptive sampling can be used to reduce the number of produced events in networked control systems. Two types of adaptive sampling, namely time-variant periodic and deadband sampling are compared in this paper from the viewpoint of the control loop performance and the number of produced events. The comparison is fulfilled based on simulations.

articleTitle: High-Power Ultra-Wideband Radiation Source
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technology of forming of high-power electromagnetic ultrashort pulses (EM USP), design, and parameters of high-voltage impulse former (HVIF) feeding impulse reflector antenna (IRA) are considered.

articleTitle: A 2-18 GHz Broadband Multi-Way Stripline Power Dividers
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The 2-, 4-, 8-way power dividers for frequency bands 2-8 GHz, 6-18 GHz, 2-18 GHz have been designed and successfully manufactured. The suspended striplines were used for implementation of power dividers which have low amplitude and phase unbalance, low VSWR and insertion loss, high outputs isolation.

articleTitle: Experimental and Theoretical Problems of Signal Processing at Vibro-Displacement Measurement by Autodyne Sensors
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical analysis is fulfilled for the algorithms and software formation for measuring signal processing and calculation of vibro-displacement parameters during the measurements using Doppler displacement measuring systems on the basis of the autodyne UHF sensors on centimeter range. The peculiarities of the registered signals are shown depending on the operating point of autodyne. The experimental results are discussed. Fulfilled UHF measurements at the container transportation confirmed the validity of the technical solution and confirmed the mathematical model and calculation approach adequacy. Checking circuit on two UHF measuring systems with fixed phase difference allows eliminating the calculation uncertainty and determination of current vibro-displacement direction. The determination error and minimal calculated displacement threshold are determined by the initial system calibration as well as by the measuring channel noise-immunity.

articleTitle: Dual-Polarized Feed-Cluster for a Reflector-Based Multi-Beam Sar Antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: EADS Astrium GmbH and Saab Space AB have designed, developed and bread-boarded a feed-cluster subsystem for a reflector-based multiple beam SAR antenna in X-Band. Flexible active phased SAR antennas are used for wide swath coverage with Envisat and TerraSAR-X as examples. Such active phased arrays are complex and still very costly. Simpler solutions with less flexibility and less wide coverage can be provided by reflector-based SAR antennas with somewhat reduced coverage. A study and development activity under ESA contract focused on a design of such antenna and a design, development, bread-boarding and testing of a dual polarized feed-cluster. Results have been used to demonstrate accurate feasibility of the reflector-based SAR antenna design, exploiting the multi-pencil-beam approach (European Patent EP1471600). The designed dual-polarized SAR antenna allows for Stripmap and ScanSAR operation over limited angular coverage around an installable pointing direction.

articleTitle: Autodyne Signal Features at Reflecting Object Vibration
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the signal generation features on the basis of the amplitude and frequency variations in the autodyne oscillator under the influence of electromagnetic wave reflected from vibrating reflecting object. Recommendations regarding correct choosing of the operating point are offered. The research carried out allows to develop the set of general points and recommendations for application in the instruments and devices for monitoring and vibration measurement, which include the following. 1. When increasing the reflected radiation level and choosing correct operating point, autodyne sensors provide almost double yield in the dynamic range compared with homodyne sensors. 2. The problems of radio wave monitoring and vibration parameter measurement should be fully solved by autodyne sensors subject to parameters and functionality of autodyne oscillators. 3. It is perspective to use modern autodyne measuring modules implemented on hybrid integrated technology.

articleTitle: UHF Self-Oscillator with Electric Control Based on Complementary Transistor Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Discussion is presented of a UHF self-oscillator based on a transistor structure. A possibility of wide-range electric adjustment for oscillation frequency generation is shown. A hybrid IC is suggested for a UHF self-oscillator based on a complementary transistor structure. Research has shown that oscillation frequency may be adjusted using control voltage, which offers a 68.5MHZ oscillation frequency tuning.

articleTitle: X-band MMIC Low-Noise Amplifier Based on 0.15 μm GaAs Phemt Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design and fabrication of X-band MMIC low-noise amplifier (LNA) based on 0.15 μm GaAs pHEMT technology is presented. The design and fabrication of X-band MMIC LNA is presented. MMIC is implemented with 0.15 μm pHEMT GaAs technology developed in the Institute of Microwave Semi-conductor Electronics (Russia). Two-stage LNA is designed with using "visual" design CAD tools. In 7-10 GHz, it provides power gain G = 15.5 -17dB, noise figure from 2.1 to 2.9 dB, input and output return losses from -8 to -12 dB, and linear output power of +6 dBm.

articleTitle: Waveguide Photonic Structures with Magnetic Control
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The behavior of one-dimensional waveguide photon structure with ferrite plates as a defect is investigated. It is possible to control transmission peak parameters by magnetic field imposing on photon structure. It is offered to use similar structures as rejection filters for millimeter, sub-millimeter and terahertz bands.

articleTitle: Multi-Abonent RFID System
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the use of homodyne method for useful signal selection. This solution allows to increase the power and noise-immunity of the system (operation distance is increased). Furthermore, interrogator can operate with several transponders simultaneously.

articleTitle: Unified Biophysical Model for Interaction of Low Intensity Laser and EHF Electromagnetic Fields with Cell Biosystems and Integral Organizm
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Unified biophysical model describing interaction of low intensive laser and EHF electromagnetic fields with cell biosystems and integral organism is proposed and experimentally verified. The role of coupling agent is played by thermolization of low intensive laser field interaction with photo-acceptor molecule. Thermolization energy spectra is calculated for single mode single-and multifrequency laser light and also for intensity modulated single mode single frequency laser light. New generation of biomedical instruments is proposed for combined low intensive IR laser and EHF therapy.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Wideband RF Stripline Directional Couplers
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new design concept of compact ultra-wideband radio-frequency directional couplers for high-power applications (up to 100 W) is presented. 3 dB stripline directional couplers operating within frequency bands 0.05-0.55 GHz and 0.1-1 GHz have been designed and manufactured. The couplers provide very high performances.

articleTitle: IFC-Based Building Geometry Models for Computer-Aided Design of Wired and Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This work is a part of CANDY research project. Computer-processed building models are used as data sources for optimized cabling tracing in buildings LAN-inside as well as constellation of access points (AP) or basis stations (BS) in WLAN and WiMAX-nets. The imported building geometry models are used in propagation models and visualization methods implemented in tools of CANDY framework. The developed methods are successfully used for design of combined networks including wired and wireless routes. The optimization aim is decreasing of total network costs, higher life duration of designed network solutions and their scalability. Characteristics and performance features of selected propagation models and design methods are evaluated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Frequency Delay Outburst in the Active Galactic Nucleus using the Discrete Correlation Function
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using methods described earlier (Volvech et al., 2006) we can eliminate certain oscillations in available data. At the same time CrAO's database contains brightness curves of large number of sources at multiple frequencies. If we determine phase relationship between founded oscillations at different frequencies we can obtain some new intelligence about properties of medium where these oscillations propagate.

articleTitle: Accurate Time Synchronization for Digital Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the basic principles of time synchronization for modern digital communication network, including the planning of time synchronization, which uses the opportunities of satellite radionavigation systems GPS and GLONASS, as well as NTP protocol. The new protocols of time synchronization are reviewed.

articleTitle: The New Type of Phase Accumulator for DDS
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are design philosophy and fabrication technique for the new type of the phase accumulator for DDS with improved characteristics of phase counts formation. Experimental model of DDS has been developed.

articleTitle: Technique for Oxidation Parameters Definition, Based on Investigation of Defects Formation Images in Silicon Inversion MOS - Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the model allowing detecting some of silicon oxidation parameters (distribution of oxygen concentration at the depth, Wegard factors, relative tension), designed on the basis of investigations regarding defects formation in the near-surface of silicon inversion MOS-structures.

articleTitle: Step-by-Step Modification of Printed Wideband Balun for GPR Antennas
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Several designs of ultra-wideband (UWB) micro-strip to slotline transitions for tapered-slot antennas (TSA) have been considered. A fourth-order Marchand microstrip-slotline balun and two transitions using wideband slot stubs and micro-strip stubs have been simulated using CST Microwave Studio. TSA employing these baluns had been designed, fabricated and tested. The results of simulations and experimental data are presented.

articleTitle: The Radio Absorptive Materials on the Basis of "Core-Shell" Nanoparticles in Polymeric Matrix
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The radio absorptive materials on the basis of "core-shell" nanoparticles in polymeric matrix of the polyethylene of the high pressure (PEVD) were developed. The composition of nanoparticles is investigated by means of Mossbauer spectroscopy method. The absorptions and reflections factors of microwave power on frequency 30 GHz were measured. It is shown that characteristics of the radio absorptive materials on the basis of "core-shell" nanoparticles are defined by their construction.

articleTitle: Transistor Large-Signal Scattering Parameters and Application in Microwave Circuit Design
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new definition of transistor large-signal scattering parameters for prescribed source and load impedances is introduced. These parameters provide the exact design of nonlinear microwave circuits. In the paper, a new definition of transistor large-signal scattering parameters for prescribed source and load impedances is introduced. These parameters relate increments of the first harmonics of incident and reflected waves at transistor ports with respect to steady-state operation. A way to calculate scattering parameters using PSPICE simulator is proposed. It is demonstrated that new parameters provide the exact design of microwave power amplifiers and oscillators.

articleTitle: Model of Wireless Transactions Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the model of wireless transactions performance. It is based on dynamic choice of transaction fixing depending on the wireless network state and wireless sites layout. The model offered allows to use wireless network hardware in full and to increase transactions reliability.

articleTitle: Measurement of Nanometer Metal Layers using Waveguide Photonic Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of using waveguide photonic structures for measuring parameters of nanometer metal layers on dielectric structures has been investigated.

articleTitle: Temperature Effects in GaAs MMIC Digital and Analog Attenuators
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental researches of temperature effects in GaAs MMIC digital and analog attenuators are presented.

articleTitle: Natural Oscillations of High-Q Resonance Macrostructures in Infrared and Optical Ranges on the Systems with Coupled Dielectric Resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new type of resonant devices including a great number of Coupling spherical form low permittivity Dielectric Resonators (DRs) has been studied. It is shown that natural oscillations of such a structure have very high Q-factor, and their field distribution has no analogs among resonators made of solid materials.

articleTitle: COFDM-Modulator
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper are the results of COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency division multiplex) modulator design, supporting the standard of ground digital TV - DVB-T (territorial). Modulator can be used in RRL of data transmission.

articleTitle: Combined Cryo-Microwave Methods for Tumors Treatment
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Combined cryo-microwave methods, applied in medicine for tumors treatment are considered.

articleTitle: Hybridization of Electromagnetic and Magnetostatic Modes in Epitaxial BaFe12O19 Films in the Domain Area
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coupled ferrite-dielectric oscillations (FDO) in the epitaxial film of uniaxial barium hexaferrite in a domain area (DA) and at saturation have been investigated theoretically and experimentally. For the first time the hybridization of high-frequency branch of FMR with a dielectric resonance mode have been found with the presence of magnetic bubbles lattice.

articleTitle: Radiowave Control of Dielectric-Based Articles
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The system for non-destroying radiowave control of dielectric-based articles at the workplace is offered. The mechanism for information readout and processing is developed, providing high control accuracy.

articleTitle: MPLS Network Hardware Reliability
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In order to analyze MPLS (multiprotocol label switching) network hardware reliability, the method of semi-Markov systems phase enlargement is used.

articleTitle: Broadband UHF Transmitting TV Antenna Consisting of Shunt Dipoles
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Broadband UHF transmitting TV antenna consisting of shunt dipoles is offered. The antenna operates at several frequency channels simultaneously. The detailed numerical and experimental research is carried out and geometry of the antenna is optimized. Antenna structure includes two orthogonal planes of radiators, power divider and matching device. Industrial sample is presented.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Power of Testing Link at Research of Microwave Propagation with Homodyne Method
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The repeater amplification is studied. This research was conducted for the microwave amplitude and phase measurements. The extreme gain dependence of microwave repeater was collected from VSWR feeder line.

articleTitle: Ku-band Airborne Satellite Communication Station
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The Ku-band airborne satellite communication station has been designed. The station is intended for application in the airborne communication system.

articleTitle: Version of the Attenuation Calculation Model of the Broadband Signal in the Radio Circuit of the Local Communications Network (Knure Wi-Fi Model)
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model for the calculation of the attenuation for the broadband signals in the multipath radio circuits of the digital information transmission systems (DITS) using the Wi-Fi technology was created. The authors called the model as the KNURE Wi-Fi model. In contrast to the well-known COST 231 model the given model provides more exact attenuation forecasting and calculation in all of three radiation zones.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo Simulation of Nonstationary Electron Transport in GaAs/AlAs Quantum Wire
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of Monte Carlo simulation of electron drift velocity response on the application of longitudinal electric field in transistor structure based on GaAs/AIAs quantum wire are presented. All the dominant electron scattering mechanisms in the structure considered have been taken into account, as wellas collisional broadening. The influence of transverse electric field on electron drift velocity is investigated.

articleTitle: Complex Technological Optimization of Microwave Devices
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The concept of complex technological optimization (CTO) is proposed, its principles are formulated, the basic theoretical positions are considered; they allow to realize CTO of microwave devices during various stages of their life cycle.

articleTitle: Periodization and the Basic Objects of Radioengineering Research in the Crimea
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the periodization regarding radio-technology development (radar, broadcasting, navigation systems, etc.). The basic objects, such as Black Sea fleet, Universities, Marine Hydrophysical Institute, Crimean As-trophysical observatory, Space telecommunication center, etc. are specified.

articleTitle: Memory in Plants Under Low-Intensity Microwave Radiation
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A phenomenon has been discovered of low-intensity microwave radiation memory retained during germination of wheat seeds. A model to describe such phenomenon is suggested.

articleTitle: Planar Antenna on Semi-Cylindrical Dielectric Resonators
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electrodynamical model of semi-cylindrical dielectric resonator planar antenna has been developed. Antenna radiation pattern has been optimized and examined.

articleTitle: Efficient RF Absorbers on the Basis of Intercalated Graphite Substances
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio absorbing materials on the basis of polyvinylchloride (PVC) plastisols and substances of intercalated graphite (SIG) presenting itself the disordered dispersed system have been developed. In such system PVC-plastisols form polymeric matrix and SIG is the filler. Two families of samples differing by specific gravity and absorption value of UHF power have been fabricated. Absorption values obtained in such materials exceed 100 dB/sm.

articleTitle: Intellegence Administration System of the Up-To-Date Telecomunication Network Based on the Up Level OSI-Model
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article deals with the intelligence administration system development conception for the up-to-date telecommunication network based on the up level OSI-model. The Web-services information technology is used for intelligence administration system designing.

articleTitle: Radiation Effects in Heterostructures on Gallium Arsenide
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The radiation effects in GaAs Pseudomorphic High Electron Mobility Transistors (pHEMT) and Resonant Tunneling Diodes (RTD) have been experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: Technology of MM-Wave Extra Powerful Impatt Diodes with Multimesa Active Structure Design
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The complex of technological receptions has allowed to solve the problem of producing multimesa mm wave band structures, in which it is possible to reduce thermal resistance in inverse proportion , where n -number of mesa structures. The sectional process engineering has general purpose character and is applicable for the most complicated materials in particular for heterostructures and all types of microwave diodes on their bases, which contain mesa structure.

articleTitle: Design of L- and S-Band MMIC Low Noise Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of monolithic low noise amplifiers design. The amplifiers operate within 1.2-1.6 and 1.5-3.5 GHz frequency bands. Design techniques are considered. Calculated characteristics are shown.

articleTitle: Active Microstrip Traveling-Wave Directional Filter
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility of developing a microstrip version of a microwave directional traveling-wave filter with resonant signal amplification is demonstrated.

articleTitle: "Visual" Design of X-Band Two-Stage MMIC Low-Noise Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An application of a new "visual" technique to design multistage low-noise amplifiers (LNA's) is presented. As an example, the design of X-band two-stage MMIC LNA is demonstrated basing on 0.15μm GaAs p-HEMT technology. The design of multistage microwave LNA's is cumbersome and time-consuming process. In this paper we demonstrate an application of a new interactive "visual" technique to design X-band two-stage MMIC LNA. The design procedure consists in the sequential implementation of two main operations for each compensation (CN) and matching (MN) network: (1) determination of acceptable regions (AR's) of CN's and MN's impedances at sample frequencies based on amplifier stage requirements; (2) synthesis of CN's and MN's from AR's. The procedure is implemented in our "visual" CAD tools, AMP, REGION and LOCUS, providing the fast and convenient amplifier design. The amplifier designed is implemented based on 0.15μm GaAs p-HEMT technology.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Amplification of Several Signals in TWTM
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of amplification of several signals with different frequencies in a traveling wave tube of M-type is given. It is shown, it is possible to get a system identical factor of amplification for of two or three signals with different frequencies by a choice of dynamic characteristics of a slowing down. The spectrum of a signal in these conditions is considered.

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Wave Beam Scattering by Thin Lossy Dielectric Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of laser wave beam scattering on the lossy dielectric cylinder is solved. Numerical calculation of scattered field spatial distribution inside and outside the cylinder is carried out and resonant field absorption effect is detected.

articleTitle: Theory of Fractals and Fractional Dimension in Physics and Engineering of Wave Processes
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the new synergetic approach on the basis of fractional measuring, fractal dimension, scaling, fractals and deterministic chaos, which has been developed in IRE RAS as applied to the problems of modern nonlinear radio physics and radio engineering since the eighties of the 20th century. Researches have been traditionally performed in the framework of modern fundamental interdisciplinary project: "Fractal radiophysics and radio electronics: Radio systems design", that was proposed and investigated in the Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of the RAS for the purpose of progress information technologies development.

articleTitle: Shielding Properties of Textile Matrixes with GEL and GEL-Powder Fillers
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effect of nature of gel and gel-powder fillers of flexible radio wave absorbers on the reflection coefficient and attenuation of electromagnetic radiation was considered. The changing of impregnated matrix properties at drying was studied.

articleTitle: The Model of the Multiterminal Network for Attenuation Calculation of the Radio Waves in the Wave Channels of the Architectural Buildings (Knure - WCAB Model)
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: From uniform positions of the theory of circuits the approach for modelling wave channels of architectural constructions (city streets and corridors of buildings) is offered for calculation of attenuations of signals in radiolines with technologies Wi-Fi and WiMAX.

articleTitle: Mechanisms of Anti-Inflammatory Effects of Low-Intensity Extremely High-Frequency Electromagnetic Radiation
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using a model of acute zymosan-induced inflammation in NMRI mice, the dependence of anti-inflammatory effects of low-intensity extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) on frequency and intensity was found. The maximum decrease in footpad edema and hyperthermia by 20% was revealed at frequencies of 42.2, 51.8 and 65 GHz, intensity of 0.1 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and exposure duration of 20 min. The pharmacological analysis has shown that arachidonic acid metabolites and histamine are involved in realization of anti-inflammatory effects of low-intensity EHF EMR.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Unequally Spaced Phased Arrays with Low Sidelobe using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the synthesis of scanning unequally spaced antenna array with low sidelobe level. The synthesis is carried out using genetic algorithms with criteria of minimax sidelobe level and minimum of mean sidelobe power.

articleTitle: Earth Segment of National Satellite Communication System Providing Operation of Ukrainian Telecommunication Network for Digital TV and Radiobroadcasting
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown, that satellite distribution network, designed by SE Ukrkosmos, being a component of the national satellite communication system (NSCS), can be used for TV and radio signals transmission to the areas of synchronous digital broadcasting.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic Characteristics of the Coupled Cavity Chain with Periodic Discontinuities
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of theoretical and an experimental research of dispersion characteristics and fields distribution of a coupled cavity chain with periodic discontinuities (CNCC) in a resonant condition are presented. Communication of displacement size of band components dispersion characteristics of non-uniform system relatively a uniform system dispersion and stopband width between them from size, number and the position discontinuities is established. Local character of field distribution on resonant modes of bands CNCC located near to longwave boundary of uniforms system is revealed.

articleTitle: Harmonics Filtration Circuit of the Microwave Power Amplifier of E-Class with an Expanded Strip
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The output circuits for rejection second and third harmonics for E-class power amplifiers with extended broadband were designed, simulated, and built. The central operating frequency is 800 MHz.

articleTitle: Equipment of «BETA TV COM» Ltd. for Broadcasting and Receiving Using DVB-S, DVB-C AND DVB-T Standards
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of development of units of digital television of the family CON are adduce. These units are produced by the enterprise serially. Presented in this paper are the results of design of CON digital TV units. The units are produced serially.

articleTitle: Design Data Calculation of Reflection-Type Fiber-Optic Gauge of Rotation Frequency
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design procedure of design data of the optical fibre gauge of rotation frequency of reflective type is developed.

articleTitle: Performance-Cost-Ratio Estimation by WiMAX/802.16 Networks Deployment
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper is focused on WiMAX-networks technical and economic assessment of the future deployment perspectives for fixed wireless access for metropolitan areas on the example of Kiev city, Ukraine. The paper includes an overview of IEEE 802.16 standard technical features and existing empirical propagation models. The visions towards to WiMAX-networks deployment are examined; technical and economical analysis (CAPEX, OPEX, and ROI) is carried out.

articleTitle: Microwave Measuring Instrument of Complex Dielectric Permeability of a Material
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The interlink ratio of a complex reflection coefficient with a complex dielectric coefficient of a plainly-parallel sheet's substance located in the rectangular waveguide loaded by the short-circuiter or other standard load are obtained. The module and argument of a coefficient reflection are defined.

articleTitle: Creation Specificity of Hot-Spot Wireless Access to Internet Network
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The variants of wireless access to Internet network and possible authentication and authorization of clients are considered. The Radiospot networks are presented.

articleTitle: On the Theory of Superheterodyne Amplification of Electromagnetic Waves in a Plasma-Beem System
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A nonlinear quadratic theory of superheterodyne amplification of electromagnetic waves in the magnetized beam-plasma system (Plasma-Beam Superheterodyne Free Electron Laser PBSFEL) is constructed. The unusual retarded electromagnetic wave is used as a pumping wave. Multi-harmonious interaction of waves is taken into consideration. Analysis of the growth increment for the signal electromagnetic wave is carried out. It is found that prospects of practical use of the considered systems for generation of especially powerful electromagnetic signals of the mm-range could be rather promising.

articleTitle: Elements of Fractal Radiosystems
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes the design of wideband elements of fractal radio systems.

articleTitle: The Module for Power Amplification of Radiopulse BPSK VHF Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is technological module of VHF power amplifier for radar and radionavigation systems with pulse BPSK signals.

articleTitle: Propagation of Two-Dimentional Soliton-Like Pulses in Coupled Ferromagnetic Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The features of nonlinear wave processes and effects of self-influence due to formation of two-dimensional soliton-like pulses at excitation of magnetostatic waves in coupled ferromagnetic structures and possibility of governing nonlinear processes in ferromagnetic films at coupling variation are considered.

articleTitle: Compact Amplitude/Phase Control Module for X-band Active Phased Array
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are design and results of experimental research of compact amplitude/phase control module to be used in transmitters and receivers of X-band active phased arrays.

articleTitle: Current Distribution in Nonlinear Loaded Circular Loop with the Core Made of Substance with Negative Real Permeability
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is current distribution in nonlinear loaded circular loop with the core made of substance with negative real permeability in small nonlinearity approximation. It is shown, that in wide limits of antenna electric sizes essential increase of current amplitude at double frequency of probing signal is observed compared with the case of coreless antenna.

articleTitle: Autogemotherapy using Blood Irradiated by Millimeter Electromagnetic Wave in Combined Treatment of Cerebral Pathology
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of human blood irradiation is considered.

articleTitle: Elements and Devices on the Basis of Kaleidoscopical Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Research of Amplitude and Phase Errors in Monopulse Antenna Irradiator Channels Effect on Aperture Antenna Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

Directional patterns of the monopulse antenna irradiator and the aperture antenna with excitation amplitude and phase errors in irradiator channels and error values dependences on the directional patterns parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Simplified Method of Quantitative Estimation of Free Water in Biological Liquids
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Radiorelay System 1.25 Gbps with DC Compensator, Realized on Digital LPF in Parallel Form
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: DC compensator of data signal is developed for the new radiorelay system with the data transmission speed 1.25 Gbps and manufactured by Micran Co Ltd. The DC compensator is based on digital LPF, which processes several data bits simultaneously (parallel form). It estimates the current DC level and, using this information, inserts the correcting bits into the data stream. The advantage of the DC compensator is relative ease of hardware realization and relative high compensation precision.

articleTitle: New Sources Ofcoherent Terahertz Radiation - Dual-Wavelength Heterolasers with Intracavity Mode Mixing

articleTitle: High Power Pseudomorphic Hemts' with Doped Channel

It has been established that the application of such measurement procedures provides different results in the LF range depending on the way of diode excitation: by DC from a DC source, or microwave oscillator. LF noise measurements of several microwave diodes are presented.

articleTitle: Spectrum-Modulated Wireless Ultra Wideband Noise Communication System
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper proposes the possibility of using UWB noise continuous waveforms for the reliable digital data transmission with high data rate and high interference immunity. Wireless noise communication system proposed operates over 3.1-4.1 GHz frequency band. Low spectral density of the transmitted noise power, high immunity against electromagnetic interference (EMI), and excellent EMC and LPI performance characterize the proposed wireless communication with double spectral processing of UWB noise continuous waveforms.

articleTitle: Elecrtic Fields from Lightning Strokes of Complicated Geometry
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Time domain electric fields are addressed in the neutral atmosphere that originate from the lightning strokes of a complicated structure of lightning channel. A model of the return stroke is used with traditional current waveform. The current wave moves along the channel with an exponentially decaying velocity. Static, induction and radiation fields are treated for the following cases: (1) powerful vertical return stroke (2) positive stroke that initiates from the ground or from the cloud top (3) 'broken' discharge (4) 'staircase' discharge, and (5) 'spider' stroke. Electric multiple pulses appear owing to current wave movement and twisting of the lightning channel. Vector of the electric field acquires transient vertical, inward/outward and sideways components, which 'scan' the sky. Atmosphere disturbances around the thunderstorm may cause fluctuations in the air density and temperature, which assist in modification of the middle atmosphere.

articleTitle: MM-Wave Modules for Short Range Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: High performance mm-wave miniature module for short range Doppler and FMCW radar sensors has been developed. The module is shown in fig.1. It includes: circular polarization diplexer, monolithic GaAs balanced mixer, power divider, and Gunn diode VCO. The low 1/f noise mixer diodes and high performance oscillator enhance the detection sensitivity at low IF frequency and circular polarization waveform improves reception ability for various radar targets. Module has been designed to be used in automotive, industrial and military sensing applications, has low cost and suitable for mass production.

articleTitle: Multimedia System for Data Communication within 11,7-12,5 GHz Band
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Broadband Horn Antenna Calculation

articleTitle: Subminiature Voltage-Controlled Oscillator Modules for Millimeter-Wave Therapy and Original Technology for their Manufacturing

articleTitle: Timed Asynchronous System Models for Dependable Mobile Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We describe two system models that allow the implementation of dependable applications in asynchronous systems. We provide assumptions that are sufficiently weak to be satisfied by real distributed systems. Nevertheless, we can show that important problems of dependable computing are still solvable. For mobile systems we weaken the assumptions even more and show that it is still possible to solve the consensus problem using eventually perfect failure detectors using communication via stubborn channels.

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Communication MIMO system with spatial diversity is considered. The signal is received in presence of correlated noise. Maximum likelihood detection algorithms for known and unknown noise correlation matrix are obtained.

articleTitle: To the Stability Theory of Electron Beam Injected into Plane Diode
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It was derived the dispersion equation on the base of analytical solution for the non-uniform hydrodynamic equation systems in the first approximation of the stability theory, relating the frequencies and increments (decrements) appearing electromagnetic oscillations with electron beam and plane diode parameters. The dispersion equation solution showed that into a diode, where the electron flow is passing, instability appears to be not described in literature earlier. This instability has place in decelerating flows, when in stationary state the diode potential minimum does not form. Physically, the instability is linear stage of phase transition from one-particle mode of moving to the mode with collective character.

articleTitle: Magnetocumulative Generators on the Basis of Multilinker Systems

articleTitle: Tunable Active Antenna Module Based on Planar Dielectric Resonator
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Design of tunable Gunn diode-based active antenna module including new type of planar dielectric resonator is presented. The module is designed in such a way that a planar dielectric resonator acts both as a stabilizing resonator and as a radiator. A ferroelectric varactor is used for radiation frequency tuning. The module operates at frequency around of 17 GHz and demonstrates the radiated power 8.8 plusmn 0.1 dBm over the tuning range 130 MHz and phase noise level -80 dBc/Hz at 100 kHz offset. 65deg width of radiation pattern in both E and H planes corresponding the gain of 5.1 dBi were measured.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of Layered Medium Parameters: The Influence of Vector Space-Time Time Response of Transceiving Antenna
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electro-physical restoration of layered medium parameters is considered. The method is based on UWB electromagnetic sounding of the medium, scattered field reception, transceiving antenna influence compensation, and estimation of medium reflection function. The method includes: measurement (or numerical calculation) of electric field component on the plane surface close to the transmitting antenna; field approximation by the superposition of elementary E and H plane waves; determination of antenna vector effective height; estimation of sufficient number of plane waves which is necessary for finding reflection function of the medium; transformation of scattered field back to the receiving antenna port. The accuracy of electromagnetic field approximation by the limited number of plane waves is investigated.

articleTitle: The Features of MM-Wave Technology Applicated for Rape Manufacture Various Stages for Biofuel
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A basic opportunity of maintenance of technology of plants raising for biofuel (as an example is rape) for various climatic zones of Ukraine with the help of regulation of its development physiological cycles due to cultivation mm-lengths of waves, in a combination with structured water is shown. The seeds of rape were preceded by electromagnetic waves of frequency 42 and 53 Hz renders stimulating influence on their germination. After electromagnetic waves influence on the seeds the rape root system becomes more active growing. It is necessary to continue works on record of enzymes on field structures of water.

articleTitle: Development of Wide Area Networks Based on Mobile Network Modules
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: The Approach for Intellectual Control Systems Fuzzy Knoweledgebase Creation
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Microdisplacement Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the new method for the measurement of microdisplacemets in optical fiber converters. It is based on light generation, i.e. parallel rays are directed towards the moving surface along the guides of hollow truncated cone.

articleTitle: The Cubic Nonlinear Theory of Electron-Wave Free Electron Lasers with H-Ubitron Injection
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: MMDS Range Subscriber Transceiver for Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Dielcometer Method for Free Water Quantity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Proposed in this paper is the method for free water quantity evaluation using the data of dielectric measurements in the field of water dispersion. It is shown that the level of free water correlates with the level of metabolism intensity in the organs.

articleTitle: Problem of Insertion Power Loss in Fiber Links for Antenna Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Power loss of microwave and millimeter wave antenna signals after their transmission through fiber links with intensity modulation and direct detection (IMDD) on the basis of both direct modulation (IMDD-DM) of laser diode and external modulation (IMDD-EM) of laser light in modulator are estimated. Noise figure dependencies at the output of microwave IMDD fiber links are calculated and illustrated graphically. Methods are described to completely solve the problem of big insertion loss, to achieve not only loss compensation, but to make IMDD fiber links with intrinsic gain of input microwave and millimeter wave signal without additional optical or electronic amplifiers. publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: On the Current Flow Mechanism in Au-TiBx-n-GaN-i-Al2O3 Schottky Barrier Diodes
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We investigated a current flow mechanism in the Au-TiBx-n-GaN-I-AI2O3 Schottky barrier diodes, in which space-charge region width is much over the de Broglie wavelength in GaN. An analysis of the temperature dependences of I-V curves of forward-biased Schottky barriers showed that, in the 80-380 K temperature range, current flow occurs as tunneling along dislocations crossing the space-charge region. The dislocation density p estimated from I-V curves (in accordance with the model of tunneling along the dislocation line) was ≈ 1.7=D7;10-7 cm-2.

articleTitle: Investigation of Pulse Induced Current in Tristron with Unresonance Output Unit
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Induced current pulses in triode-klystron (tristron) have been researched using numerical simulation. It is shown that tristron can generate subnanosecond pulses with the ultra high repetition rate.

articleTitle: Coupled Electromagnetic and Magnetostatic Oscillations in Hexaferrite-Dielectric Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coupled electromagnetic-magnetostatic oscillations over 60-75 GHz in strontium hexaferrite-quartz structures have been investigated. articleTitle: Multicriteria Optimization in Telecommunication Networks Planning
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Information systems are developing swiftly. That is why requirements to the quality and terms of communication facilities design are increased. Nowadays communication systems are designed using CAD software [1-3]. Previously at the stages of schematic, engineering and technological design high processing speed and PC memory were used. Now the actual problem is the automation of initial design phase. It is the phase of systems engineering, which is determined by system design for the specified application area. At the same time it became necessary to introduce new technologies for systems engineering. The foundations are the theory of multi-objective optimization and probabilistic modelling of communication systems. These technologies combine two main directions. The first direction comprehends development and realization of the methods for multi-objective optimization of communication systems in order to select optimum designed system versions by vector optimality criterion. The second direction comprehends the development of probabilistic mathematical communication models and appropriate software for communication systems simulation. As a result, we have problem-oriented program complexes for computer-aided communication systems engineering. It is also important to provide methodical and technical training for the specialists in the field of automation of communication systems design. It is very important and relevant to organize remote electronic education courses.

abstract: Investigation of continuum absorption (CA) depending on humidity in a mixture of nitrogen and water vapor at the atmospheric pressure has been conducted within 100-210 GHz frequency range at two temperatures: 297 K and 274.5 K using resonator spectrometer. articleTitle: Application of Various Nature Fields for Indemnification of Space Stations Negative Factors Influence on Fitosystems
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Opportunities of indemnification of negative influence of space factors upon fito-system in conditions of orbital space stations are considered. abstract: The results of development of W-band phased antenna array (PAA) elements with Faraday type phase shifters is shown. articleTitle: Microstrip Band-Pass Filter with Parasitic Bandwidths Suppression

Minimization is carried out using the method of radiator envelope shape synthesis. Functions determining HR envelope shape at which its length possesses minimal value without changing the given reflection factor (RF) and the factor of basic wave transformation into the waves of the superior types (TF) have been obtained. Using CAD method HR envelope profiles with horn opening cross section 23×10mm and horn mouth cross section 80×34,8mm for the wave lengths from λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub>= 2,4 cm to λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub>=3,6cm at target values RF=0,07 and TF=0,03 have been determined. The HR simulated in this way has smaller length compared with HR with rectilinear envelope provided the same RF and TF values. The method proposed allows operating HR key parameters. By putting together curvilinear envelopes of different shapes it is possible to achieve simultaneous reduction of HR RF and TF. The results obtained can be used, for example, at design of SHF mirror antennas irradiators with increased requirements to the orientation diagram, efficiency and overall dimensions.

articleTitle: Electroforming Assembly - New Technology for Manufacturing Components and Units of Communication and Navigational Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A set of millimeter-wave components and devices made by multi-layer electroforming is presented. It is shown that the proposed technology makes possible quasi-monolithic multifunctional devices for communication facilities. The basic requirements for the microwave system of spaceborne equipment both for research and satellite communication are small mass and size, low cost and high reliability. Our technology based on multi-layer electroforming in combination with electroforming assembly, which has repeatedly proved its efficiency, makes possible large-scale integration multifunctional microwave devices. Its distinctive feature is a special electrodepositing regime that provides a fine-grain structure and high plasticity of the metals, and reusable knock-down matrices provide not only high manufacturing accuracy, but also the identity of the electrical parameters of the devices being manufactured. Besides, electroforming assembly makes possible monolithic multifunctional modules without any butt joints, the waveguide wall thickness being only 200 to 300 mum as opposed to several millimeters in conventional structures thus offering far smaller mass and size of the device as a whole.

abstract: Considered in this paper is the introduction of digital broadcasting in Ukraine taking into account foreign experience and development of microwave terrestrial, satellite and cable networks. Results of successive operation of DVB-T experimental zone within 470-862 GHz in Kiev and Odessa are presented. It is necessary to create hi-tech products, first of all universal tuners and transmitting devices using the achievements in the fields of microwave technology and microelectronics. Peculiarities and aspects are discussed regarding the introduction of wideband wireless technologies on the basis of existing UMDS systems and UWDS within 10150-10300 MHz, 10500-10600 MHz and 11700-12500 MHz. Results of microwave digital TV broadcasting and data transmission are presented within the frameworks of UWDS project in the Crimea on the basis of MITRIS technologies.

articleTitle: Calculation of Modulation Disturbance, Caused by Homogeneous Turbulences in the Atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The phase disturbance caused by homogeneous turbulence is derived for a monochromatic linearly polarised electro-magnetic wave in a medium. The index of refraction is described as n = 1 + ōn(x,y,z,t). Assuming homogeneous turbulence, the path is determined using the variation procedure based on Euler-Lagrange, with which the propagation path is derived using Fermat's Principle. The average of the time-derivative of the phase can be derived, when the path and so the phase integral is determined. The average of the second derivative of the phase gives an interesting impression for the phase disturbance. For systems exploiting frequency modulation, a signal is demodulated by differentiation of the instantaneous phase angle as f(time). A variance of the instantaneous phase has been derived using the above mentioned process.*

This method assumes spectral optimum designing dynamic characteristics of filters in the form of spectral representations, on the basis of matrix equation according to a minimum of an average square-law mistake.

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the problem of signal generation on the amplitude variation taking into account frequency variations in autodyne oscillator under the influence of electromagnetic wave reflected from the object under control with reflection factor modulation. It is shown that autodyne response waveform may essentially differ for the modulation function law. The results of the theoretical analysis are confirmed by experimental investigation of the oscillators designed on the basis of hybrid integrated modules "Tigel-08" and "Tigel-08M" in millimeter waveband. Theoretical analysis carried out and experimental investigations results show that autodyne signal waveform with amplitude modulation of the electromagnetic wave reflected from the stationary object may essentially differ from the modulation function law. This feature should be taken into account at radio physical investigations of various substance features, in radio spectroscopy, as well as in short-range radar.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Photonics Methods and Equipment for Study of Internal Structure of Materials
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio-spectroscopy of millimeter region enables to research separation of energetic levels in crystal fields, to measure Electron Paramagnetic Resonance in materials of high anisotropy, to research antiferromagnetics and semiconductors, to work out quantum generators in millimeter and sub-millimeter regions. We obtained experimental results on different materials in the range of wave lengths from 8 up to 2.2 mm.

articleTitle: The Features of Electron Density Variations in Ionospheric D-Region Near Kharkiv During the Magnetic Storm in December, 2006
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The changes of the electron density in the middle latitude ionospheric D-region during the magnetic storm in December, 2006 have been investigated using partial reflection technique. Quasi-periodic (with periods of T≥30-60 minutes) 50-100% increase of electron density during tens of minutes was found. The estimations of ionization rate change have been carried out. Corresponding fluxes have been estimated on the basis of experimental data of electron density changes over the electron and proton precipitation periods. publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Modelling of SAR Transceiver as a Complex System
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An object-oriented model of SAR transceiver has been designed.

articleTitle: Coding and Processing of Graphic Information in Telecommunicational Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for the graphic information processing allowing coding the contour images by means of complex numbers uniquely defined by form of the image and solving problems of the recognition: identification of an object and determination of figure orientation on the plane was developed.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Interference Microwave Converter Based on Compact Power Transducers
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Improved Energy Performance of Gyrotron Material Processing Plants
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Two principal approaches are suggested to improve power efficiency of microwave material processing using gyrotron-based systems. The first approach involves increased power of depressed-collector gyrotrons, while the second - optimized dual-parameter power control of gyrotrons.

articleTitle: Spatial Quantization Accounting in Single-Electron Device Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Physical model of single-electron transistor taking into account spatial quantization effect is described.

articleTitle: Human Water-Electrolyte System as the Initial Object of Millimeter Wave Influence
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Suggested in this paper is the new model of structure and dynamics of pure water. It is supported by complex dielectric permittivity and absorption data within the whole range of polarization orientation. This model is generalized to the aqueous electrolyte and nonelectrolyte solutions.The structural specification of mm frequency band is established. The primary target of mm emission is proposed.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Optimazation in Phase Array with Digital Control Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Phase array controlled by digital phase is considered. Correction of array elements phase based on genetic algorithm used for sidelobe level optimization is proposed. Numerical examples have proved the method efficiency.

articleTitle: The Influence of Material Synthesis Time and Pumping Intensity on Terahertz Gas-Discharge HCN Laser Parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Oscillation Efficiency of Diodes with Al0,3Ga0,7As/GaAs Cathode
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A TED with resonance tunnelling cathode have been considered. It is possible to obtain generation in the diode structure at the expense of TEE and cathode negative resistance. Generation conditions for both mechanisms are determined. Oscillation efficiency and frequency limit have been calculated.

articleTitle: Investigations of Coupling Coefficients of Resonators in Stripline Filter on Suspended Substrate
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Heat Generation in High Power hemt's Size Estimashion
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A simple model for the heat generation area size depending on HEMT topology and active layers properties is developed. It is shown that real heat generation area size is much less than transistor structure period and the gate drain distance.

articleTitle: H-Polarization Modes of Multi-Mirror Open Resonator with Echelette
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: H-polarized oscillations of the complex multi-mirror open resonator have been researched. One of the resonator mirrors is represented by echelette reflective grating.

articleTitle: The System Evrika-VVV for Multiprogram TV and Data Flows Transmission via Analog Radio Links
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Considered in this paper is the new system for multiprogram TV and data flows transmission via analog radio links. Structure flowchart, as well as peculiarities and results of putting into practice are described. The system high efficiency has been confirmed at transmission of four TV programs and 4 X E1 flow using one of the trunks of "Kurs-6", "Kurs-4", "Express", "3600-2MB", "Gelios" radio links. It has been shown that advanced methods of signal processing make it possible to considerably increase frequency using efficiency, as well as amount of the services provided.

articleTitle: The Method of Information Reading from Calibrated Microwave Transduser in Real Time Mode
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The new method of measurement results processing for the purposes of module and phase complex reflection coefficient determination is suggested. The calculated values of sought parameters array and three-dimensional addresses for readout are formed by this method.

articleTitle: Radiochannel Estimation Method of the MISO Scheme for the WIMAX System in the Conditions Over Time-Varying Multipath Fading
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The effective method of channel estimation for OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) systems with MISO (Multiple Input Single Output), with space-frequency and space-time-frequency block coding is offered. The offered method consists of 2th scheme: initial estimation of channel with a simple trial character and update of information about a channel during the period of data communication.

articleTitle: Chaotic Wide-Band Generation of Microwave Signal in Hybrid System "Traveling Wave Tube with Collector-Oscillator"

articleTitle: High Power Microwave Pulses are not Genotoxic and Possess Anti-Inflammatory Effects
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It was shown that high power microwave pulses (HPMP) did not cause any direct genotoxic effects on native frog erythrocytes, human whole-blood leukocytes and isolated lymphocytes exposed in vitro. It was found that exposure of water solutions to HPMP induced formation of hydrogen peroxide in nanomolar concentrations due to the mechanism of thermoacoustic activation of dissolved oxygen. It was revealed that HPMP could produce anti-inflammatory effect which is comparable with the action of therapeutic doses of sodium diclofenac.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Studies of Properties of L, M-BAND Waveguide Slotted Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Waveguide slotted antenna arrays (WSAA) are the special class of multibeam microwave antennas, which are widely used both in independent transmitting or receiving devices, and in the elements of complex antenna system. Nowadays WSAA is one of perspective airborne antenna system which has found wide application in radiolocation, radionavigation and radiocommunication devices. Being multiple beam airborne antenna system, WSAA have a number of incontestable advantages: (i) absence of projecting parts; (ii) simple realization of optimum antenna radiation characteristics by means of forming so much of the main lobes and their directivity, width of the main lobes, side radiation level, etc. In Measuring Systems Research Institute (NIIIS) the procedure of scientific research, design and production technology for rectangular multiple beam millimeter WSAA with specified radiation parameters have been introduced. Taking into account specificity of the WSAA as airborne antenna systems, we have studied the case of the round aperture array. Recently the broadband and ultra broadband antenna systems have been designed. The results of bandwidth research are also presented in this paper. Theoretical and experimental studies have demonstrated that: (i) one of the possible ways for WSAA overall dimensions optimization is rounding of its rectangular aperture, that leads to improvement of WSAA radiating properties, namely sidelobe level decreasing; (ii) WSAA can be used for radiation - reception of broadband signals with the bandwidth up to 2 GHz.

articleTitle: Receiving Module for Wideband Digital Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: EHF Electromagnetic Radiation Influence on Bacillus Subtilis Metabolic Activity
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microbiotechnology is one of the most dynamically developing fields of biotechnology. Using microbiotechnology enzymes, antibiotics, high-pured preparations are received. We studied the influence of EHF electromagnetic radiation on growth and physiological activity of bacteria Bacillus subtilis.

articleTitle: Anisotropic Radially Three-Layer Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Eigen oscillations of a radially three-layer cylindrical dielectric resonator bounded with two perfectly conducting end surfaces are studied. The characteristic equation for the anisotropic resonator buried into anisotropic medium is obtained. The numerical investigations of the resonator with internal and external layers made of Teflon and middle layer filled with transformer oil or distilled water are carried out. Spectral and energy characteristics of resonator for different thicknesses and positions of middle layer are represented.

articleTitle: Exact Excitation Equations for the Cavity
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The exact excitation equations for unloaded cavity resonator with finite conductions of the walls were received by projection method.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Ship Radio Personnel Training in the Questions of Navigation Safety
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Within the limits of teaching experience exchange, a point of view is stated regarding GMDSS operators training in the field of navigation safety informatization.

articleTitle: Angular Resolution Increasing in Processing of Radionavigation Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper are the methods for radar objects imagery with increased angular resolution, as well as algorithms, which are necessary for information reprocessing. articleTitle: Microwave Imaging of Objects Inside Concrete

articleTitle: Main Conceptual Positions of the Use Teleport "Ukrkosmos" for Support of the Operation to Network Terrestrial TV Broadcasting in Standard DVB-T

publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Influence of Dielectric Constant of Background on Optical Properties of Metallodielectric Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We theoretically study the effect of the dielectric background in two-dimensional metal-dielectric photonic crystals. We calculate the photonic band structure by means of the plane wave expansion method. Results show that the band structures shift toward lower frequencies and become flatter when the background dielectric constant increases. In addition, degeneracy can be broken and new gaps can be created in function of the dielectric background. We also found that the relative band gap width ΔΩ/Ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub> grows with increasing background dielectric constant and widths as large as 42.3% and 13.8% for the second and third band gaps can be achieved for ε<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sub> = 9.

articleTitle: Universal Corporate Wireless Network Architecture

abstract: Principles of universal wireless network design are considered. A possibility for the universal convergence wireless network design is offered on the basis of SONA service-oriented architecture.

articleTitle: Chaotic Radiopulse Generator on the Basis of Electron Beam with Virtual Cathode
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the novel system for chaotic pulses generation based on electron beam with virtual cathode in retarding field. Processes numerical simulation in the generator offered has been carried out. articleTitle: X-Band Hybrid Power Amplifiers for Phased Array Application
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: X-band pre- and output amplifiers for phased array has been designed and fabricated. The power gain of pre-amplifier is greater than 20 dB; output power is greater than 1 Watt. abstract: Considered in this paper is inherent mm-band electromagnetic radiation of acid (HCI) and alkaline (NaOH) solutions with different concentration. The results of investigation are described and dependence of radiation level on solutions conductivity is shown.

articleTitle: Research of Radiation Characteristics of Wire Log-Periodic Antennas
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of researches of characteristics of radiation wire log-periodic antennas are presented. The opportunity of formation of the unidirectional radiation in a wide range of frequencies is shown.

articleTitle: Development of Nonstantionary Gas Spectroscopy Method for Noninvasive Medical Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibilities of using of the microwave gas spectroscopy method for investigation and analysis of exhaled air are considered. The results of tests measurements in 2-mm range are presented. The prospects of investigations in teraherz and subteraherz ranges are shown.

articleTitle: New Type of the Generator on the Goffered Resonator
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Report is dedicated to study of the possibility of designing a new type of electronic device, namely a generator on the goffered open resonator, the three-dimensional bunching of electron beam does not occur in it; however, reaching the high efficiency of the conversion of the power of electrons beam into the power of the electromagnetic revolving wave is possible. articleTitle: Fractal Clusterization Influence Upon Radioabsorbing Properties of Composite Materials
publicationTitle: 2007 17th International Crimean Conference - Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of distribution of particles upon radio-absorbing properties of composite materials was investigated. abstract: Prospects for the development of ultrashort pulse sources with ultra-high repetition frequency on the basis of vacuum tube technology are discussed. Predicted pulse spectrum exceeds a decade. These sources may be used for particle acceleration and in new radars.
